observations.body: The tempter displays the world’s kingdoms and their glory, attaching their transfer to an act of worship.
observations.label: The kingdoms of the world are offered

observations.body: The passage places World kingdoms beside the kingdoms of the world are offered.
observations.label: World kingdoms

payload.posture: Read Matthew 4:1–11 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the tempter displays the world’s kingdoms and their glory, attaching their transfer to an act of worship. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The kingdoms of the world are offered
